text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Tuesday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
LIETUVOS RYTAS

- Although the draft project of the National Investigation Bureau to fight corruption has been drawn up, officials from the prosecutor's office, interior ministry and state security department are sceptical about it.
- Lithuania will not grant political asylum to a Russian citizen Alexander Konanych and his wife, suspected of economic crimes and who are waiting for deportation from the United States.
- The trial of the alleged January 13 1991 coup plotters continued in Vilnius on Monday.
- Inflation in Lithuania was 13.1 percent in 1996, the lowest since the restoration of independence.
- One of the most profitable companies of the oil industry, Klaipeda Oil Terminal, increased its heating oil exports in 1996 by 1.5 times.
RESPUBLIKA
- A court decided to arrest for one month the head of a customs check point suspected of illegal import of cigarettes worth $200,000.
- Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius urged the head of the statistics department, Kestutis Zaborskas, to resign.
- The price of cold water in Vilnius rose to 1.84 litas from 1.56 litas in January.
LIETUVOS AIDAS
- Lithuanian Foreign Algirdas Saudargas said on Monday in Warsaw that close co-operation between the two countries is necessary since in the future they would be neighbours in the European Union.

- The reconstruction of Siauliai airport in northern Lithuania will cost $40 million, $30 million of that taken from the British Midland Bank but it remains unclear when, if at all, the project will make a profit, the newspaper writes.
- Vilnius lacks organisations to take care of homeless people in winter and the main burden lies on hospitals.
VERSLO ZINIOS
- Lietuvos Energija has enough reserves of heating oil to last until the middle of February.
- Arthur Andersen is carrying out the annual financial audit of the central bank for the second year in a row.
- Dealers say that the price of Hermis Bank shares rose by 52.6 litas and Vilnius Bank went up by 41 litas in one month.

- The Lietuvos rytas daily newspaper has 65,000 circulation and 35,000 subscribers, Kauno diena 55,200 and 46,000, Respublika 44,200 and the data on subscription was not available, Lietuvos Aidas 18,000 and 12,000 while Verslo Zinios had 9,300 and 7,029.
